summary: Iteration 167 bug fixes testing complete. All 3 reported bugs verified as fixed: (1) Midnight processing - trade processes_at now schedules at midnight UTC-8 after review period, (2) Traded pick ownership - auto-pick correctly awards player to new pick owner (current_team_id), (3) Sandbox login - @sandbox.local emails return 401 (not 500).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 (Midnight Processing): trades.py lines 1005-1015 correctly calculates midnight UTC-8 using timezone(timedelta(hours=-8)) and next_midnight calculation. When review_period_hours is 0, processes_at is set to now (immediate).

Bug Fix 2 (Traded Pick Ownership): draft_helpers.py lines 281-301 correctly queries draft_picks by (league_id, draft_id, round, original_team_id) and uses current_team_id when it differs from original_team_id. Same fix applied in draft_pick_actions.py lines 139-163.
Bug Fix 3 (Sandbox Login): server.py line 229 changed UserLogin.email from EmailStr to str, allowing @sandbox.local addresses without Pydantic validation errors.
_resolve_review_period_hours function (trades.py lines 93-117) correctly supports trade_review_period_days (0-7) with proper fallback to hours and default of 24h.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data and unit tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 167 verified 3 specific bug fixes: (1) Midnight UTC-8 processing for trades, (2) Traded pick ownership in auto-pick, (3) Sandbox @.local email login. All tests pass. The _resolve_review_period_hours function supports 0-7 days config with proper fallback chain.

midnight_processing.description: processes_at now calculated as midnight UTC-8 on the day after review period expires. When review_period_days=0, processes immediately.

traded_pick_ownership.description: Auto-pick and manual pick now query draft_picks by (league_id, draft_id, round, original_team_id) and use current_team_id for traded picks.

sandbox_login.description: UserLogin.email changed from EmailStr to str, allowing @sandbox.local addresses without validation errors. Returns 401 (invalid credentials) instead of 500.
